references.text: Ezekiel describes God's role as the one who calls his sheep by name and leads them out, an image that John 10:3 directly reuses to illustrate the Messiah's relationship with the people.
Here is expressed the theme of God gathering and leading out his sheep from the nations, which corresponds with the action in John 10:3 where the sheep are led out through the gate.
The prophecy that a single shepherd will stand over the sheep and lead them is the theological background for the image in John 10:3 where the shepherd calls them by name.

Isaiah describes the shepherd gathering the lamb in his arms and leading those who are pregnant, an image of the personal care and leadership also highlighted when the shepherd calls the sheep by name in John 10:3.
